The '''Kharazi Jungle''' is an area south of [[Shilo Village (location)|Shilo Village]] on [[Karamja]]. This is where most of the [[Legends' Quest]] takes place, and it is necessary to start the quest in order to enter the jungle (you only have to talk to [[Radimus Erkle]] and receive [[Radimus notes]]). A [[machete]] and a [[Woodcutting]] [[axe]] are required to hack through the dense jungle blocking the path along with the notes. [[Radimus notes]] is required to navigate it if players have not completed Legends' Quest.

The jungle often serves as the location for [[Treasure Trail]] co-ordinates.

The jungle is home to the [[Kharazi tribe]] and several species of wolves, birds, and other animals, most of which are [[aggressive]]. To the north-west is the [[mossy rock]] that acts as the entrance to the [[Shaman Caves]] and [[Viyeldi caves]], which has a role in Legends' Quest. Along the southern beach are several [[vanilla plant]]s, which players will find a use for during the [[Sir Amik Varze]] subquest of [[Recipe for Disaster]]. Roughly in the centre of the jungle is a pond with special water and near it is a location where special [[Yommi tree seeds|Yommi trees]] may be planted. Along the jungle there are several black totem poles which players will have to get rid of during Legends' Quest.
[[File:Legends' Quest - Viyeldi caves entrance.png|thumb|The entrance to the Viyeldi caves.|none]]
This location is also visited again for the [[death wing]], [[oomlie wrap]], and [[palm leaf]] tasks from the [[Karamja Diary]]. A palm leaf can be retrieved by shaking the [[leafy palm tree]]s to the east and west of the small pool in the centre of the jungle. When shaken, a leaf will appear on the ground.

To the south-east is the [[Karamjan Temple]], which is visited during [[Dragon Slayer II]] in order to find one of the dragon key pieces.

==Transportation==
[[File:Easy entrance to Kharazi Jungle.png|right|thumb|This spot is one of the easiest way to enter the jungle from Shilo Village.]]
There are several easy ways to enter the Kharazi Jungle from [[Shilo Village (location)|Shilo Village]]:
* One of the easiest ways to enter the jungle coming from Shilo Village is to stand by the jungle tree south of Shilo Village's east fence. Cut the most north-eastern jungle tree from the north-west tile (as pictured), followed by the jungle plant further south.
* Players with 79 [[Agility]] and completion of [[Legends' Quest]] can use a [[vine (Kharazi Jungle)|vine]] shortcut on the east side of the jungle to pass through.
* To the west of Shilo Village is a Jungle tree that can be cut down to directly cross the jungle.
